answer: Re-attestations are stored in canyon and harbor lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ember graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 550 impostors cost 917 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
